answer_1.quote: Evaluating Data-to-Text natural language generation (NLG) systems is a very important task despite its notorious difficulty.
datasets: the development set released along with the task

answer_2.quote: We propose to pre-annotate the game summaries (i.e. identify potential errors) using a set of rules and text classifiers.

answer_4.quote: The human evaluation was conducted in two subsequent stages; the annotator first validated the development set and then the test set
answer_4.guideline: the annotator is asked to follow the evaluation guidelines provided by Reiter and Thomson
